Initial release of docker-essentials-v1-tool-free, providing classic Docker V1 command support for legacy environments:

- Supports V1 container lifecycle management (run, stop, start, restart, remove, prune).
- Enables V1 image creation, management, cleanup, and tagging operations.
- Includes V1 container debugging and inspection commands.
- Provides V1 Docker Compose orchestration for service deployment and management.
- Offers V1 environment compatibility checking and migration assessment tools.
- Targets developers maintaining legacy Docker systems and preparing for V1 to V2 migration.
